correlationBoundary: Only the selected native sink-submit caller sites, same retained render client, and an observed sink invocation may emit device rows. ReleaseBuffer carries the successful same-invocation GetBuffer capture ID and returned buffer as extraArgument. The extra argument is observer context, not a fifth API argument.
bufferBoundary: GetBuffer records HRESULT and reads its out pointer only on S_OK. ReleaseBuffer reads min(256, releasedFrames*4) bytes before forwarding, provided frames do not exceed the successful request. This is a bounded prefix independent of the whole interleaved channel extent. No release-return buffer read is allowed.
lifecycleBoundary: The worker discovers and hooks at most four distinct targets per method. Early selected sink calls can precede installation and are counted as bootstrap skips. Disabled trampolines and bounded target-module references remain resident until process exit, matching source-hook cleanup.

evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected native triplet, borrowed complete sink caller, render-client IID and virtual-call slot declarations.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Paired SDK HRESULT calls, same-client buffer identity and bounded bytes before release; runtime implementation targets are observed, not cataloged or assigned a pinned OS build.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: S_OK, nonnull readable output pointer, current selected sink scope, exact caller return site, matching client and frame bound. Zero/nonzero HRESULT is preserved as raw unsigned bits, not replaced or reinterpreted as source status.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Unobserved early calls, complete buffers, endpoint identity/format history, asynchronous lifetime, device processing and audibility.
